answer_1.quote: Syntactically-controlled paraphrase generation, which aims to generate paraphrases that conform with given syntactic structures, has drawn increasing attention in the community.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the quality of paraphrases with: 1) alignment-based metrics to examine the semantics preservation: including BLEU, ROUGE scores and METEOR between the generated paraphrase and gold paraphrase. 2) syntactic conformation metrics: Tree-Edit Distances (TED) scores between the constituency parse trees of generated paraphrases versus exemplar sentences (TED-E) and parallel-annotated paraphrases (TED-R).

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. We validate the chosen paraphrases for the first 100 instances in the test sets on Amazon Mturk... We ask workers to vote for which one is the best.
answer_4.guideline: We ask workers to validate if the paraphrase is natural, fluent, and preserves the semantics of the source sentence.
